title: Experiment: the stage view — three boundaries, a refused document, and an unknown stage
summary: `/stage/[stageId]` built as `ƒ` and was served against a copy of `planning-content`. A valid stage returned 200 with all three regions resolved: `data-vpw-criteria="06-risk-feasibility"` with both criterion markers, `data-vpw-document="06-risk-feasibility.md"`, and `data-vpw-review="AST-0021"` showing `draft`. The same response also carried `data-vpw-loading="document"` — the criteria region had resolved while the document region was still showing its own fallback, which is the two boundaries resolving independently, observed rather than inferred. Replacing the document with `<Danger>` produced 200 with `data-vpw-document="rejected"`, `data-vpw-rejection-at="planning-content/stages/06-risk-feasibility.md:3:1"`, the diagnostic escaped as `<Danger>`, and both criterion markers still present. Replacing it with a permitted `<Callout>` rendered `data-vpw-mdx="Callout"` and an `<h1>`. An unknown stage id, and two traversal-shaped ids, each returned 200 carrying Next.js's visible not-found UI.

facts.contentRoot: a disposable copy; the project's own content was not touched

omissions.reason: `notFound()` is called inside a Suspense child, so the status is already committed when the stage turns out not to exist — the response is 200 carrying the not-found UI. Returning 404 would mean validating before streaming, which means reading in the route entry, which the boundary check refuses. The failure is visible; the status is not available to make truthful.
No write capability exists yet by design: DEC-0021 reviews locking capabilities one at a time and TSK-0012 owns the first. The panel shows identity and status and says the action is unavailable.

Independence was observed because the document read is genuinely slower than the criteria read, not because either was artificially delayed. A deliberate delay would prove it on demand; nothing here forces the ordering, so the observation is real but not reproducible on command.

notes: ⚠️ THE STAGE ID NEVER BECOMES A PATH. It is matched against the stage definitions by object key and against document names by exact comparison over a directory listing, so a traversal-shaped segment is simply an id that matches nothing. There is no sanitising step, which is why there is no sanitising step to get wrong. ⚠️ THE ESCAPED DIAGNOSTIC IS THE PART WORTH KEEPING. The message quotes agent-authored source; rendered as markup it would let a refused document inject into the page reporting its refusal, turning the safety mechanism into the delivery route.
